info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Hotel Rooms Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Cancellation API allows users to cancel previously booked hotel rooms efficiently. This operation is vital for managing bookings, especially when customers need to modify their reservations. Typical consumers include hotel management systems and travel agencies that require seamless integration for room cancellations. The API not only facilitates the cancellation process but also ensures that the inventory is updated in real-time to reflect availability. It provides a straightforward endpoint for handling cancellations, thereby enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously booked room. It effectively removes the reservation from the system, making the room available for other customers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details needed to cancel a room reservation. It requires the necessary identification and reason for cancellation.

200.description: The cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteHotelRoomsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a room operation through a DELETE request.

DeleteHotelRoomsCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Operation Response

DeleteHotelRoomsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful cancellation operation.
